cards.title: Mother-in-law's girly clothes for daughter
cards.body: A parent struggles with mother-in-law buying overly feminine clothing for their daughter. Advice columnist Eleanor Gordon-Smith explores the balance between letting girls express individuality and avoiding enforcing different stereotypes.

cards.title: Parenting lessons at Ikea with your son
cards.body: Zoe Williams reflects on taking her son to Ikea and confronting her parenting gaps. The pre-university shopping trip reveals how much domestic wisdom parents have actually imparted to their children.

cards.title: Finding community in suburban family life
cards.body: Shadi Khan Saif's family moved to Melbourne suburbs expecting boredom but discovered unexpected excitement. The family learned to appreciate their new suburban home and found community in unexpected places.

cards.title: Blind parents can now feel baby scans
cards.body: Tactile 3D models created from pregnancy scans help blind parents-to-be experience their babies before birth. This innovation supports expectant blind parents with a meaningful way to connect with their unborn children.

cards.title: Stop blaming kids for technology design
cards.body: The real problem with children and screens isn't the kids themselves but the machinery designed to capture their attention. Understanding how tech affects developing brains helps parents address deeper issues around attention and reward.

cards.title: What screen time is really replacing
cards.body: Before limiting your child's screen time, consider what the screen is actually replacing in their life. This question reveals whether technology use is filling a genuine need or avoiding something important.

cards.title: Teen rescued after days adrift in Alaska
cards.body: A 15-year-old boy was rescued after days adrift in Alaskan waters following a fishing vessel capsize. His brother and cousin tragically did not survive the ordeal.
